game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths, a rich ore vein: the cave miner must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths: a rich ore vein

win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 23 before the cave gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
